tasks.behavior: Select relevant checks and reuse fresh results without duplicate verification
acceptance: Local verification selects checks by changed responsibility, keeps broad staging checks, and exposes its plan.
Passing checks are reused only for matching inputs; failures stop execution; wrapup never reruns tests.
Live provider tests are explicit and browser verification does not silently reuse existing servers.
Measured before and after timings cover documentation, backend changes and repeated verification.
